resources.string: Photo Order Fix
Your memories, back in\nthe order you took them

Photos moved from your iPhone showing up backwards in Instagram or KakaoTalk? Those apps sort by when a file arrived on the phone, not when it was taken. This app finds each photo\'s real date and re-saves them oldest first.
Find the real date of every photo
Re-save them oldest first

%1$d of them are in a folder Android doesn\'t let apps save into (like iPhoneData from Smart Switch). Their copies go to the same folder name under DCIM, so album names stay the same.

How it works: each item is copied with identical content, oldest first. Then Android asks you once per batch to allow deleting the originals. If you decline, the copies are removed and nothing changes.

Cloud sync can stay on: re-saved copies are identical to the originals, so Google Photos and the Gallery treat them as the same photos. If some photos still show up twice afterwards, turn off sync in the Gallery (Menu → Settings → Sync photos and videos); your cloud photos are not deleted by that.
Good to know: \"Favorite\" marks in your gallery app may be lost. Your gallery\'s own order does not change. Some apps only show the new order after you restart them.

To keep each photo\'s location, allow "Media location" access. Without it Android hides location data from apps, and the re-saved copies would lose it.

Dates wrong after a transfer? Google Photos keeps the date each photo had when it was backed up. Download those photos with Google Takeout (takeout.google.com), then pick the .zip files here. Only dates earlier than the one on your phone are used.
